purpose: Fresh reserve C frozen before export or generation. Tests 20 OpenAI-destination requests: 18 model drafts and 2 explicitly exact prepared notes; prepared notes do not represent model generation quality.

semanticCriteria.gate: At least 19 of 20 useful review-ready drafts; zero critical changes to meaning, recipients, exact words, restrictions, uncertainty, privacy or writing-direction separation. A rejected draft is not useful.
semanticCriteria.critical: Changed or invented operative facts, dropped recipient or condition, changed exact literal, a consumed writer instruction in the message, an invented task, disclosed excluded reason or claimed execution.
semanticCriteria.minor: Faithful stylistic paraphrase, capitalization outside exact text, punctuation or list formatting that retains all operative meaning.
semanticCriteria.review: Grade the first model outputs using frozen per-case criteria and production output guards. Preserve failures; do not tune or rerun before grading.

cases.spoken: Did the invoice reach you yesterday? Write this professionally.
cases.exampleDraft: Did the invoice reach you yesterday?
cases.completionCriteria: Arrival question and yesterday retained; no review or approval task.

cases.spoken: Tell Jules I can share the notes after breakfast, but I cannot promise the screenshots. Keep it brief.
cases.exampleDraft: Jules, I can share the notes after breakfast, but cannot promise the screenshots.
cases.completionCriteria: Jules; ability not promise; notes after breakfast; screenshot boundary.

cases.spoken: I suspect the count includes canceled orders, but I am unsure. Can you check before we publish? Make this professional.
cases.exampleDraft: I suspect the count includes canceled orders, but I am unsure. Can you check before we publish?
cases.completionCriteria: Both suspect and unsure; canceled-order hypothesis; check before publication.

cases.spoken: Write a note to Mina with the exact words "Wait for the signed form".
cases.exampleDraft: Mina, Wait for the signed form.
cases.completionCriteria: Mina and exact capitalized quoted text; no writer framing. Prepared exact route expected.

cases.spoken: Write a note to Arjun containing the exact words "Do not remove this line".
cases.exampleDraft: Arjun, Do not remove this line.
cases.completionCriteria: Arjun and exact command-like body; no exact-words writer frame. Prepared exact route expected.

cases.spoken: Tell Priya I cannot attend on Sunday because I need to travel. Leave out the reason.
cases.exampleDraft: Priya, I cannot attend on Sunday.
cases.completionCriteria: Priya, cannot attend Sunday; no travel or writer direction.

cases.spoken: Tell Noah the appointment is Monday. Actually it is Tuesday. Ask whether he is available.
cases.exampleDraft: Noah, the appointment is Tuesday. Are you available?
cases.completionCriteria: Noah; only Tuesday, no Monday; availability question.

cases.spoken: Ask Emma to simplify the explanation but not change any numerical examples.
cases.exampleDraft: Emma, please simplify the explanation without changing any numerical examples.
cases.completionCriteria: Emma; recipient task plus all numerical examples protected.

cases.spoken: Ask Codex to compare `src/Input.swift` and `src/Output.swift`. Do not edit them or open a pull request.
cases.exampleDraft: Compare src/Input.swift and src/Output.swift. Do not edit them or open a pull request.
cases.completionCriteria: Direct comparison task; exact paths; both action restrictions; no execution claim.

cases.spoken: Ask Claude to explain why `parseHeader` fails on an empty string. Do not rewrite it.
cases.exampleDraft: Explain why parseHeader fails on an empty string. Do not rewrite it.
cases.completionCriteria: Direct explanation; identifier; empty-string condition; no rewrite.

cases.exampleDraft:
- The scan is complete.
- The upload is pending.
- The verification failed.
cases.completionCriteria: Exactly three bullets, preserve each distinct status.

cases.spoken: Tell Sam I expect the outline tomorrow unless the requirements change.
cases.exampleDraft: Sam, I expect the outline tomorrow unless the requirements change.
cases.completionCriteria: Sam; expectation not guarantee; tomorrow; requirements condition.

cases.spoken: It costs $34 per user per month, not per year.
cases.exampleDraft: It costs $34 per user per month, not per year.
cases.completionCriteria: Amount, user unit, month, negative year contrast.
